source.content: public class ScheduledBatchFixtureBatch implements Database.Batchable<Integer> { public Iterable<Integer> start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { return new List<Integer>{1, 2, 3}; } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<Integer> scope) { insert new Account(Name = 'scheduled-batch:' + bc.getJobId() + ':' + scope.size()); } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { AsyncApexJob job = [SELECT Id, Status, JobType, TotalJobItems, JobItemsProcessed, NumberOfErrors, CronTriggerId FROM AsyncApexJob WHERE Id = :bc.getJobId()]; System.assertEquals('Completed', job.Status); System.assertEquals('BatchApex', job.JobType); System.assertEquals(0, job.NumberOfErrors); System.assertNotEquals(null, job.CronTriggerId); } }

@isTest private class AsyncScheduleBatchLifecycleFixtureTest { @isTest static void schedulesBatchWithDefaultScope() { Test.startTest(); String cronId = System.scheduleBatch(new ScheduledBatchFixtureBatch(), 'batch default', 1); System.assert(cronId.startsWith('08e')); Test.stopTest(); CronTrigger cron = [SELECT Id, State FROM CronTrigger WHERE Id = :cronId]; System.assertEquals('Complete', cron.State); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM AsyncApexJob WHERE JobType = 'BatchApex' AND Status = 'Completed']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'scheduled-batch:%:3']); } @isTest static void schedulesBatchWithExplicitScope() { Test.startTest(); String cronId = System.scheduleBatch(new ScheduledBatchFixtureBatch(), 'batch scoped', 1, 2); Test.stopTest(); CronTrigger cron = [SELECT Id, State FROM CronTrigger WHERE Id = :cronId]; System.assertEquals('Complete', cron.State); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'scheduled-batch:%:2']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'scheduled-batch:%:1']); } }
